nd2aadafc589.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Mushikonda grant to Jains – Kubja Vishnuvardhana
nd2aadafc589.x: Ammaraja II made the Kaluchumbarru grant at the request of Chamekamba; Mushikonda village was granted to Jains by Vishnuvardhana III.

n0ed2c0aa319.s: Eastern Chalukya temples of the Vengi School mainly followed which architectural style?
n0ed2c0aa319.x: The Eastern Chalukyas mainly followed the Dravida style, blending Pallava and Badami Chalukya influences with local Andhra features; this tradition is called the Vengi School.

nap-history-18-7.s: Who built the twin Bhimeswara temples at Draksharama and Samalkot?
nap-history-18-7.x: Chalukya Bhima I built the twin temples Draksharama Bhimeswara and Kumararama Bhimeswara (Samalkot). Prola Raju II and Rudra Deva were Kakatiyas and Anavema Reddy a Reddi king.

nc69201d3f5a.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nc69201d3f5a.x: Bhimeswara is at Draksharama. Kumararama is at Samalkot, Kumaraswamy at Chebrolu and Someswara at Gunupudi near Bhimavaram.

n1159a3805c0.s: Who shifted the Reddi capital from Addanki to Kondavidu?
n1159a3805c0.x: Anavema Reddy shifted the Reddi capital from Addanki to Kondavidu.

nap-history-16-1.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nap-history-16-1.x: Vijaya Deva Varma belongs to the Salankayana dynasty. Pulakeshi I is linked with the Chalukyas, Gundyana with the Kakatiyas and Prolaya Vema Reddy with the Reddy kingdom.

nb827e592dc3.s: The Pithapuram inscription of Velanati Prithvisvara names which lake?
nb827e592dc3.x: The Pithapuram inscription of the Velanati Choda Prithvisvara names Kolleru Lake (APPSC 2017).

nindian-history-147-18.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-147-18.x: Nagavarma II wrote Kavyavalokana. Manasollasa is by Someshvara III, Mitakshara by Vijnaneshwara and Vikramankadeva Charita by Bilhana.

n9c9a57f804a.s:
Arrange the following Imperial Chola rulers in order of succession:
A. Rajaraja I
B. Vijayalaya
C. Rajendra I
D. Aditya I
n9c9a57f804a.x: The succession runs Vijayalaya, Aditya I, Rajaraja I and Rajendra I.

nindian-history-148-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Aditya I – Loss at Thakkolam to the Rashtrakutas
Kulottunga I – Defeat of Pallava Aparajita
Rajendra I – Naval expedition against Kadaram and Srivijaya
nindian-history-148-13.x: Rajendra I sent the naval expedition to Kadaram and Srivijaya. Aditya I defeated Pallava Aparajita, Parantaka I lost at Thakkolam and Kulottunga I abolished tolls.

nindian-history-148-16.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Naval expedition against Kadaram and Srivijaya – c. 1035 CE
nindian-history-148-16.x: Thakkolam was fought in 949 CE. Brihadeeswara was completed in 1010 CE, the Kadaram–Srivijaya expedition sent in 1025 CE and Gangaikondacholapuram built around 1035 CE.

nb24d97f37ca.s: Which of the following pairs of Chola village committees is correctly matched?
o: Pon variyam – Gold and financial matters
Samvatsara variyam – Tanks and distribution of water
nb24d97f37ca.x: Pon variyam dealt with gold and finance. Samvatsara variyam handled annual works, eri variyam tanks and water, and thotta variyam gardens.

nindian-history-43-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-43-13.x: Virupaksha is at Hampi. Lingaraj is in Bhubaneswar, Jagannath in Puri and Dilwara at Mount Abu.

nindian-history-43-14.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-43-14.x: Khajuraho temples are in the Nagara style. Kailasanathar is Rajasimha style, the Mahabalipuram Rathas are Mamalla style and Chausath Yogini is circular.

n3f3dd7cac2f.s:
Arrange in chronological order:
A. Brihadeeswara Temple
B. Shore Temple
C. Gangaikondacholapuram Temple
D. Seven Pagodas of Mahabalipuram
n3f3dd7cac2f.x: The order is Seven Pagodas of Mahabalipuram, Shore Temple, Brihadeeswara and then Gangaikondacholapuram.

n245d03e3ed0.s: In which year did Ballala III die, after which the Hoysala territory passed to Vijayanagara?
n245d03e3ed0.x: Ballala III died in 1342, and the political space of the Hoysala kingdom then passed to Vijayanagara.

nindian-history-149-2-11.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-149-2-11.x: Kanchi was the Pallava capital. Warangal was Kakatiya, Dwarasamudra Hoysala and Madurai Pandya.

n27e6e5665a4.s: Which set contains only works or grants of Ganapatideva's reign?
o: Ramappa temple, Lakkavaram tank, Ghanapur tank and Ganapavaram villages
Arikesari Samudram, victory pillar at Srisailam and Betesvaralayam
Thousand Pillar Temple, Kadalalaya Jainavasadi and Kesamudram tank
Kesamudram tank, Jain Juddha Mallajinalaya and Swayambhu temple
n27e6e5665a4.x: Ramappa temple, the Lakkavaram and Ghanapur tanks and the grant of Ganapavaram villages belong to Ganapatideva's reign.

nap-history-18-8.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavala – Chalukya Bhima I
nap-history-18-8.x: The Jaina Basthi was built by Mailamma. Bhimeswara Temple was built by Chalukya Bhima I, the Thousand-Pillar Temple by Rudra Deva and the Swayambhu Devalayam by Prola Raju II.

nindian-history-149-2-10.s: Which of the following pairs of dynasty and capital is correctly matched?
nindian-history-149-2-10.x: The Pandyas ruled from Madurai. The Yadavas ruled from Devagiri, the Kakatiyas from Warangal and the Hoysalas from Dwarasamudra.

nbe67060eea0.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nbe67060eea0.x: Amir Khusrau called Prataparudra II Ravaddar Dev. Ganapatideva was Andhra Deshadhiswara and Rudradeva Maharaja was Rudrama Devi's male regnal name.

n10f096b2c4d.s: The title 'Rayagajakesari', for a victory over the Yadavas of Devagiri, is associated with:
n10f096b2c4d.x: APPSC keys (GS 2018, G2 2017) give Rayagajakesari to Rudrama Devi for repulsing the Yadavas; one PYQ book key gives it to Prataparudra. Prola I was Arigajakesari and Ganapatideva Andhra Deshadhiswara.

nap-history-29-14.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Rudra Deva ascended the throne in 1158.
2. Kumaragiri Reddy ascended the throne in 1386.
3. Durga Nripathi ascended the throne in 1296.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nap-history-29-14.x: Rudra Deva acceded in 1158 and Kumaragiri Reddy in 1386. 1296 is the accession of Pratapa Rudra, not Durga Nripathi.

nfe80ba3b942.s: The Venetian traveller Marco Polo visited the Kakatiya kingdom during the reign of:
nfe80ba3b942.x: The APPSC G2 2011 key places Marco Polo's visit (landing at Motupalli) in Rudramadevi's reign; he reached the Coromandel coast in 1292, at the very end of her reign or just after.

n3b2b253dbed.s:
Arrange the following Kakatiya administrative units from the largest to the smallest:
A. Grama
B. Rashtra or Mandala
C. Sthala
D. Nadu or Bhumi
n3b2b253dbed.x: Rashtra or Mandala was the largest unit, followed by Nadu or Bhumi, Sthala and Grama.

nb0caca4c7fb.s: Which of the following pairs of state and military-land arrangement is correctly matched?
nb0caca4c7fb.x: The Vijayanagara arrangement was the Amaranayaka system. The Kakatiya one was Nayankara and the Mughal parallel was the jagir.

nap-history-37-4.s: Which of the following pairs of tax and its object is correctly matched?
o: Meruka – Tax on trades and looms
Putti Wahindi – Cess on dry lands
nap-history-37-4.x: Putti Wahindi was the cess on dry lands. Pullari was the tax on grazing grass, Meruka the tax on wet lands and Moturpha the tax on trades and looms.

nap-history-37-17.s:
Which of the following taxes are associated with the Kakatiyas?
1. Koru
2. Meruka
3. Pullari
nap-history-37-17.x: Koru and Pullari were Kakatiya levies. Meruka was a wet-land tax of the Reddis.

n5ab6ad2ee8c.s: In Kakatiya society, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Vaishyas or Komatis – Five artisan groups
n5ab6ad2ee8c.x: Brahmins were known as Mahajanas. Komatis formed the Nakaram, Panchavarmavaru were Saaminumani vaaru and Panchanamuvaru the five artisan groups.

n06466edfedc.s: According to the Kakatiya-period legal principle, a woman's property passed to her:
o: Sons alone through the male line
The king after the woman's death
n06466edfedc.x: The recorded principle (cited from Ketana's Vijnaneswaramu and Purushartha Saramu) was that a woman's property passed to her daughters and daughter's daughters, a comparatively progressive outlook.

n32a35bd8ea9.s:
Consider the following statements about Kakatiya temple institutions:
1. Temples were associated with monasteries and feeding houses.
2. Kalamukhas provided anna dana.
3. Temple women and courtesans sustained dance and music.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n32a35bd8ea9.x: All three are correct: temples had monasteries and feeding houses, Kalamukhas gave food charity, and temple women (Kalavatis) sustained dance and music.
